# Roomy

> Roomy is a mobile app for shared living that simplifies household management, expense splitting, and roommate coordination.

Roomy helps roommates organize their shared spaces and finances through digital tools designed specifically for shared households. The platform is available on iOS and Android, with a focus on making shared living less stressful through transparent bill splitting, task management, and household coordination features.

## Key Topics

- shared living
- household management
- bill splitting
- expense sharing
- roommate coordination
- mobile app
- iOS and Android
- shared housing
- task management
- GDPR compliance
- data protection
